title: 第202章 你们准备好了吗第201章 五行寂灭光
slug: 寻仙启示录第204章有区别吗
content_zh:
...
因为，她能感受到左丘辰此刻体内那股澎湃到几乎要溢出来的力量，也能感受到他心中的豪情壮志...
从九州大陆一路走到今天，他们经历了太多，付出了太多。
但今天，这些付出终于换来了质的飞跃...
准帝境界、五行齐聚、剑尊之境、五行天目、八千五百层神魂壁垒，还有那正在孕育中的五行归一混沌种子。
好家伙，这其中的任何一项放在外界都是足以让无数天才疯狂的机缘。
而左丘辰在这一次雷劫中，全得到了....
嗡！
但就在这时，左丘辰忽然感应到本源塔内传来一阵异常的波动。
唰！
下一刻，他心念一动，神识探入本源塔。
紧接着，他的脸上露出了惊喜之色。
“不是，今天是个什么好日子？”
“这是要各路开花的节奏啊！”
众人一听，也是露出疑惑之色。
“还有惊喜？”
“我丢，你比挂逼还要牛！”
顿时，萧飞也是猜到了什么然后情急之下爆了粗口。
哗哗哗！
“小源牛逼...不是，源哥厉害！”

这时，欣喜之下的左丘辰也脱口而出道。
原来，本源塔的时间流速，在他步入准帝后竟然再次提升了。
原本八十倍的时间流速，此刻已经变成了一百倍。
也就是说，塔内一天顶得上外界一百天....
“一百倍时间流速！”
好家伙，左丘辰都忍不住握紧了拳头。
这意味着什么？
意味着距离万妖台大比还有不到两个月的外界时间，在本源塔内就是将近十六年。
十六年的时间，足够他将五行归一彻底完成，足够他将剑尊境界完全巩固！
甚至足够他再做突破，冲击更高的层次...
而且，一百倍时间流速对本源塔内的仙辰阁弟子们来说也是一个巨大的福音。
要知道，那些正在冲击瓶颈的年轻一代强者，在本源塔内修炼十六年，外界的对手们只修炼了不到两个月。
这个时间差，足以让仙辰阁的整体实力再上一个台阶！
“恭喜阁主渡劫成功了！”
“恭喜二弟，恭喜弟妹！”
下一刻，城中传来震天的欢呼声。
当下，紫金闪电貂族的族人们激动得热泪盈眶。
他们的阁主，他们追随的领袖，在如此恐怖的雷劫中不仅活了下来，还变得更强了....
而这种亲眼见证奇迹诞生的经历，让每一个仙辰阁的成员都感到无比自豪。
呼！

同样的，易师长出了一口气，擦去额头上的冷汗。
他活了这么多年，今天这次观劫绝对是他人生中最刺激的经历。
看着那座被左丘辰用五行天目打穿的荒山遗迹，易师心里忽然涌起一个念头...
那就是，有左丘辰在，这次万妖台大比，仙辰阁说不定真的能创造奇迹。
而此刻，九幽仙城外，那些隐藏在暗处观劫的各势力探子们，一个个面色如土。
content_en:
...
Because she could feel the power in Zuo Qiuchen's body that was so surging that it was almost overflowing at this moment, and she could also feel the pride and ambition in his heart...
From Jiuzhou Continent to today, they have experienced too much and sacrificed too much.
But today, these efforts have finally yielded a qualitative leap...
The quasi-emperor realm, the gathering of the five elements, the realm of the Sword Master, the five elements' celestial eye, the 8,500-layer soul barrier, and the gestating chaos seeds of the unification of the five elements.
Good guy, any one of these is enough to drive countless geniuses crazy to the outside world.
And Zuo Qiuchen got everything in this thunder disaster...
Buzz!
But at this moment, Zuo Qiuchen suddenly sensed an abnormal fluctuation coming from the Source Tower.
Uh-huh!
The next moment, with a thought in his mind, his consciousness penetrated into the Origin Tower.
Then, a look of surprise appeared on his face.
"No, what kind of good day is today?"
"This is the time for all parties to blossom!"
When everyone heard this, they also showed doubts.
"Is there any surprise?"
"I'm sorry, you're even better than a dick!"
Suddenly, Xiao Fei guessed something and cursed out of desperation.
Wow!
"Xiao Yuan is awesome...No, Brother Yuan is awesome!"
At this time, Zuo Qiuchen, who was overjoyed, also blurted out.
It turned out that the flow rate of time in the Origin Tower actually increased again after he entered the quasi-emperor.
The time flow rate that was originally eighty times has now become a hundred times.
In other words, one day inside the tower can hold up to one hundred days outside...
"Time flows one hundred times faster!"
Good guy, Zuo Qiuchen couldn't help but clenched his fists.
what does that mean?
This means that there are less than two months of outside time before the Ten Thousand Demons Platform Competition, and nearly sixteen years in the Origin Tower.
Sixteen years is enough time for him to completely unify the Five Elements, enough time for him to completely consolidate the realm of Sword Master!
Even enough for him to make another breakthrough and hit a higher level...
Moreover, a hundred times the speed of time is also a huge boon to the Xianchen Pavilion disciples in the Origin Tower.
You must know that the young generation of strong men who are hitting the bottleneck have been practicing in the Origin Tower for sixteen years, while their opponents from the outside have only been practicing for less than two months.
This time difference is enough to bring the overall strength of Xianchen Pavilion to a higher level!
"Congratulations to the Pavilion Master for successfully overcoming the tribulation!"
"Congratulations to the second brother, congratulations to the younger siblings!"
The next moment, loud cheers came from the city.
At that moment, the people of the Purple-Gold Lightning Mink Clan were so excited that their eyes filled with tears.
Their Pavilion Master, the leader they followed, not only survived such a terrifying thunderstorm, but also became stronger...
And this experience of witnessing the birth of a miracle makes every member of Xianchen Pavilion feel extremely proud.
call!
Similarly, Master Yi took a deep breath and wiped the cold sweat from his forehead.
He has lived for so many years, and watching the robbery today is definitely the most exciting experience in his life.
Looking at the ruins of the barren mountain that Zuo Qiuchen had penetrated with his Five Elements Celestial Eye, a thought suddenly came to Master Yi's mind...
That is, with Zuo Qiuchen here, Xianchen Pavilion might really be able to create miracles in this Ten Thousand Demons Competition.
At this moment, outside Jiuyou Fairy City, the spies from various forces who were hiding in the dark to watch the disaster all had pale faces.
